name: CSS - Layout & Positioning
description: Learn about flexbox and positioning elements

rules.text: Create a container div with flexbox display
rules.hint: Create: <div class="container"></div> then style: .container { display: flex; }. Flexbox is great for layouts!

rules.text: Add multiple items inside the flex container
rules.hint: Add items: <div class="container"><div class="item">Item 1</div><div class="item">Item 2</div><div class="item">Item 3</div></div>

rules.text: Center the content and add gap between items
rules.hint: Update container: .container { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; }. This centers and spaces items.

completion.message: 🎉 Fantastic! You can now create flexible layouts!
